# HTML Viewer

> HTML Viewer is a free browser-based editor for HTML, CSS and JavaScript with live preview, multi-file projects, responsive viewport testing and local ZIP import or export.

## Primary pages
- [Open HTML Viewer](https://instantviewer.online/): Interactive editor and live preview.
- [Spanish overview](https://instantviewer.online/es/): Spanish-language product explanation and editor link.
- [About HTML Viewer](https://instantviewer.online/about/): Product scope, local-first architecture and intended users.
- [Guides](https://instantviewer.online/guides/): Practical documentation index.

## Technical guides
- [Live HTML preview](https://instantviewer.online/guides/live-html-preview/): Rendering, debugging, responsive testing and preview boundaries.
- [Multi-file HTML editor](https://instantviewer.online/guides/multi-file-html-editor/): Entry pages, relative paths, folders and local assets.
- [Import and export projects](https://instantviewer.online/guides/import-export-html-projects/): ZIP preparation, validation and unified HTML export.

## Policies
- [Privacy](https://instantviewer.online/legal/privacy/): User code is processed locally; third-party website resources and consented analytics are documented separately.
- [Cookies](https://instantviewer.online/legal/cookies/): Necessary preferences and optional analytics consent.
- [Legal notice](https://instantviewer.online/legal/): Conditions and service boundaries.

## Verifiable product facts
- No account or paid plan is required.
- User-written code and imported project files are processed in the browser rather than stored as hosted projects.
- Simple mode prioritizes immediate single-document preview.
- Files mode supports separate HTML, CSS, JavaScript and asset files with folder paths.
- Projects can be exported as ZIP, written to a local folder when supported, or compiled into a unified HTML document.
- The interface supports English and Spanish.
